summary: SecurityHome MVP fully validated end-to-end. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass: admin auth + CRUD on sites/tenants/sensors, arm/disarm (admin & portal) with persistence in security_arm_states and pending entry in security_panel_commands, Contact ID ingest (auth check, code 130 creates alarm + sets sensor zone 1 state=triggered, code 402 updates arm_state), alarm list & ack, portal login with type=security_portal JWT, portal /me + /sites + /sensors + arm/disarm/panic (panic creates critical alarm with origin=portal), portal tenant isolation (cliente@teste.com from fleet portal correctly rejected with 401 in security portal). Frontend portal at /?portal=security renders login (data-testid security-portal-login), cliente@casa.com/123456 logs into dashboard (data-testid security-portal-dashboard), arm-away button changes site state to 🔴 Armado total within polling window, logout returns to login. Admin panel under Frota → Segurança Residencial renders security-home-page testid, lists seed site 'Casa Principal - Rua Teste 123' with Armar/Parcial/Desarmar/Sensores buttons; Sensores modal shows the 3 seed sensors with Porta de entrada flagged 'triggered'; Alarmes tab visible with 5 alarmes ativos KPI. No blocking defects.

minor.issue: Duplicate key 441 declared twice in dict (lines 230-231 in /app/backend/routes/security_home.py). Harmless (second one overrides identically) but confusing.

issues: Multiple recharts console warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' on initial mount — pre-existing on demo dashboard, unrelated to SecurityHome module but worth fixing to clean console.

action_items: Optional: dedupe Contact ID code 441 in CONTACT_ID_MAP
Optional: portal dashboard could show a loading skeleton instead of 'Meus imóveis (0)' while GET /sites is in-flight (visible briefly right after login)
critical_code_review_comments: security_home.py is 714 lines — borderline acceptable, but admin/portal/ingest could be split into 3 files for future maintainability.
INGEST_TOKEN is read at module import time. If env changes, server must be restarted (consistent with rest of codebase, acceptable).
_check_ingest_token() permits empty token bypass when INGEST_TOKEN unset — defensive default OK but log a warning at startup if missing.
Portal token TTL = 30 days with no refresh path — acceptable for MVP but document as a follow-up.
Good: MongoDB _id excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0}.
Good: tenant isolation enforced via _portal_tenant_q on every portal endpoint.

Good: all interactive UI elements expose data-testid (security-portal-login, security-portal-dashboard, security-portal-arm-away-{sid}, security-portal-disarm-{sid}, security-portal-panic-{sid}, security-portal-logout, security-home-page).
test_credentials: admin@empresa.com/123456 (main app, super_admin); cliente@casa.com/123456 (security portal); SECURITY_INGEST_TOKEN read from /app/backend/.env

context_for_next_testing_agent: SecurityHome MVP is stable. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_security_home_mvp.py covers admin CRUD, ingest, portal flows, tenant isolation, panic and ack. Run as: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_security_home_mvp.py -v. Frontend uses ?portal=security route. Note: Code 441 duplicated in CONTACT_ID_MAP (cosmetic). The 'Meus imóveis (0)' briefly displayed after portal login is a render race — sites populate via subsequent fetch and arm/disarm/panic work end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects requiring RCA. All requested features verified.
